alternatives.sourceText: CNF floor: every flip path needs at least two of your senators at the Galactic Senate (Card12_179.java L169-L172; captives do not count)
three of your senators at the Galactic Senate (L171)
with the two-senator floor held, one of them carrying a blockade agenda completes the alternative (L172). CNF of (3 OR (2 AND blockade)) = (>=2) AND (>=3 OR blockade), exact because 3 implies 2.
flips back when fewer than two of your senators remain at the Galactic Senate (Card12_179_BACK.java L171); holding two or more keeps the back stable

alternatives.sourceText: The actual gate is ordinary control of Tracked Fleet's current Episode VII system at the start of the owner's turn. Supremacy is the objective-provided executable route because it moves to that host for free; another legal control source also satisfies the gate
While Kylo controls Salt Plateau, cancel opponent Force retrieval and prevent opponent drains where their character or permanent pilot is alone

dynamicLocationRules.sourceText: Tracked Fleet starts on D'Qar and the opponent may relocate it up to three times, so the control target is the active owned Fleet card's current attached Episode VII system

terminalForfeitRules.sourceText: Place the objective out of play only if Kylo was just forfeited to Lost Pile from a battle the owner lost at Salt Plateau while Han, Leia, or Luke was present
